semantic_reading.0x4da0: Calls 0x4b00 and 0x4cc0, writes the helper result to the first DWORD of a 72-byte config buffer, calls RegCreateKeyExA(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, "Software\Disney Interactive\Hercules\1.00", reserved=0, class=NULL, options=0, access=0x20006, security=NULL, &key, &disposition), and if key is non-null writes the whole buffer as REG_BINARY value "Config" with size 0x48 then RegCloseKey.
semantic_reading.0x4b00: Calls 0x1fe0 and stores the low byte of its signed-byte result in config offset 12.
semantic_reading.0x1fe0: Loads a pointer from data cell RVA 0x361bc and returns the signed byte at pointer-value + 14, sign-extended to int.
semantic_reading.0x4cc0: Returns 0x94375494 plus 32-bit reads starting at each byte offset 4..67 in the config buffer (overlapping reads).
semantic_reading.callers: 0x4b00 is also called at 0x966a; 0x4cc0 is also called at 0x4d4a.
